data.body: Deferred until the current Phase 2/root-migration assignments are complete. Scope: prove Hive Flow agents are reliable under real workloads before inter-agent communication is prioritized. Requirements: battle-test CLI/API/local LM Studio providers, verify sign-in/session parity for CLI agents such as agy vs a normal terminal, run max-agent/concurrency pilots up to provider limits, ensure stalled agents are automatically nudged or escalated to queen only when appropriate, ensure blockers get structured redirection/help, and require agents to produce stamped completion/results. Include watchdog blindspot analysis to avoid spam loops when agents are genuinely blocked or waiting for queen intervention.
data.title: Deferred: battle-test provider agent harness and auto-recovery
